headline: Pakistan extended its airspace ban on Indian aircraft until 5am on November 24, 2026, through a NOTAM issued by the Pakistan Airports Authority.

card.desc: Pakistan Airports Authority NOTAM keeps airspace closed to Indian aircraft.

caption:
Pakistan has extended its airspace ban on Indian aircraft until 5am on November 24, Geo News and Dawn reported. The Pakistan Airports Authority issued a NOTAM on Saturday; the restriction was first imposed in April 2025.
